body:
Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30 03:38Z, my own slip on the DL560 w-2144 probe). A remote waiter of the form `ssh host 'while pgrep -f "<script-name>" >/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; …'` never ends. pgrep -f matches the waiter's own `bash -c` command line, which contains the same string. The probe ended at 03:18Z, but my END went out about 20 min late.
FIX: wait on a log marker the script writes at its end (for example `until grep -q '^POST' LOG; do sleep 20; done`), or on a recorded PID (`while kill -0 $PID`). Never pgrep -f a string that appears in the waiter itself.
Also: after a TermAl restart, my local background ssh watchers die but the remote runs continue. Re-attach marker-based waiters, and check status read-only before assuming any run died.
